lines.cap: Britain's most powerful men used to crawl deep into a cave at night. And do whatever they wanted.
lines.say: Britain's most powerful men used to crawl deep into a cave at night. And do whatever they wanted.

lines.cap: 1750s, England. A rich politician named Sir Francis Dashwood starts a club. Its motto: do what you will.
lines.say: 1750s, England. A rich politician named Sir Francis Dashwood starts a club. Its motto: do what you will.

lines.cap: He has workers dig tunnels deep into a hill, with a hidden chamber at the bottom. The Hellfire Caves.
lines.say: He has workers dig tunnels deep into a hill, with a hidden chamber at the bottom. The Hellfire Caves.

lines.cap: Members include the man running the Royal Navy, and a famous rebel politician. They dress as monks. Their guests, reportedly, dress as nuns.
lines.say: Members include the man running the Royal Navy, and a famous rebel politician. They dress as monks. Their guests, reportedly, dress as nuns.

lines.cap: To reach the inner chamber, you cross an underground stream. They named it the River Styx. The river to hell.
lines.say: To reach the inner chamber, you cross an underground stream. They named it the River Styx. The river to hell.

lines.cap: Then one night, a member smuggles in a baboon dressed as the devil, and lets it loose during their ritual. A grown lord screams for mercy.
lines.say: Then one night, a member smuggles in a baboon dressed as the devil, and lets it loose during their ritual. A grown lord screams for mercy.

lines.cap: And the man who ran this cave? He became Chancellor of the Exchequer. In charge of Britain's money.
lines.say: And the man who ran this cave? He became Chancellor of the Exchequer. In charge of Britain's money.
